svg.title: Personal portfolio. Next.js, React, and Anime.js, published on GitHub Pages.
svg.desc: A server-first portfolio built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Anime.js powers the motion design; a static export runs on GitHub Pages. Screenshot of the published portfolio with a gentle horizontal pan.
